entries.scope: Document the absdd-image-sandbox field-test closeout for Secure Development Assurance Governance v0.1.3.
entries.rationale: The preset-only recommendation, evidence results, scope exclusions, human approval boundaries, and review dates must be explicit and traceable.
entries.navigationImpact: The existing integration record links the current canonical field report; no new public landing page is required.
entries.languageStrategy: German first and English second in reader-facing Markdown; controlled JSON field names remain English.
entries.platformAndExampleProof: macOS Bash and PowerShell evidence, immutable package tests, static Compose validation, and GitHub delivery checks are recorded; no image or runtime change is claimed.
entries.risk: A scope change or stale evidence could make the preset-only recommendation invalid; dated technical and regulatory reviews constrain that risk without accepting it.
entries.reevaluationTrigger: Re-evaluate on preset, baseline, evidence, image, runtime, delivery, cloud, commercial-use, market-placement, customer-handover, support-contract, or manufacturer/steward changes.
